trans-unit.source: Heya, <Suzu>. You should enjoy yourself and try laughing sometimes.
trans-unit.target: Heya, <Suzu>. You should enjoy yourself and try laughing sometimes.

trans-unit.source: Do you enjoy yourself every day?
trans-unit.target: Do you enjoy yourself every day?

trans-unit.source: Oh, of course! Of course I do!
trans-unit.target: Oh, of course! Of course I do!

trans-unit.source: Someone told me that you were an idiot, but enjoyed yourself all the same.
trans-unit.target: Someone told me that you were an idiot, but enjoyed yourself all the same.

trans-unit.source: Aha! It had to be YOU! You've been poisoning this young girl's mind with your lies, huh!?
trans-unit.target: Aha! It had to be YOU! You've been poisoning this young girl's mind with your lies, huh!?

trans-unit.source: Come back here! I'm gonna barbecue you!
trans-unit.target: Come back here! I'm gonna barbecue you!

trans-unit.source: Hmhm... Oh, was that a laugh?
trans-unit.target: Hmhm... Oh, was that a laugh?
